title: Vectopen 0.2.3-beta: a new vector brush, text on a path, precise editing and 10,000-element documents
summary: Six days and 64 changes since 0.2.2: a new brush engine (Krita-like pencil, shape and pattern brushes), text on a path with on-canvas handles, professional node editing and selection, zoom up to 190,000 %, smooth 10,000-element documents, five ad campaigns as tests, lower memory use and a first Android preview.

title: Vectopen 0.2.2-beta: a deep interface review, 10 languages, ten real jobs, and the app now updates itself
summary: 106 changes since 0.2.0-alpha: open Affinity files, text that edits like Office, two complete reviews of the Smart, Modern and Pro interfaces (31 issues), the whole interface translated into 10 languages, zero debugger errors, ten real designer jobs, and update alerts with one-click download and install.

title: Vectopen 0.2.0-alpha: three interfaces and the first downloads
summary: The first build you can download for Windows, macOS and Linux. Smart, Modern and Pro interfaces, gradients on strokes, a much better layer panel, 750+ tests — and how you can help keep it going.

title: Artboards, layers, and a magnet
summary: The recent stretch in one place: the multi-artboard rewrite, the professional layer panel with clip masks, the smart snap system, formal undo state, and a fresh website.
